small_guidance: The matmul kernel itself looks fine; the correctness issue likely comes from replacing nn.Linear with a transposed weight while the GPT-2 lm_head is tied to wte embeddings — after replacement, the tied weight is no longer shared/used correctly. Skip replacing the lm_head (or any Linear whose weight is tied to the embedding) and verify Conv1D's weight layout (Conv1D stores weight as [in, out] already, so use it directly without transpose). Also ensure replace_linears runs before the .to(float32) cast so parameters are consistent.
large_guidance: Redesign the replacement pass to (1) detect tied weights (lm_head shares wte.weight in GPT-2) and either keep PyTorch's F.linear for tied modules or share the same parameter tensor in TritonLinear, (2) handle Conv1D correctly: its forward is x @ weight + bias with weight shape [nf_in, nf_out], so feed weight directly as B without transpose, (3) cast model to float32 BEFORE wrapping so TritonLinear captures the final dtype, and (4) add a numerical sanity unit test against F.linear/Conv1D on a small input inside __init__ to catch layout bugs early.
